pairs: After these things, having departed from Athens,
et inveniens quemdam Judæum nomine Aquilam,
And upon finding a certain Jew named Aquila,
who had recently arrived from Italy with Priscilla his wife,
et Priscillam uxorem ejus (eo quod præcepisset Claudius discedere omnes Judæos a Roma),
(because Claudius had ordered all Jews to depart from Rome,)
And because he was of the same trade,
Et disputabat in synagoga per omne sabbatum,
And he was arguing in the synagogue on every Sabbath,
introducing the name of the Lord Jesus.
And he was persuading Jews and Greeks.
Cum venissent autem de Macedonia Silas et Timotheus,
And when Silas and Timothy had arrived from Macedonia,
Paul stood firm in the Word,
testifying to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.
But since they were contradicting him and blaspheming,
excutiens vestimenta sua, dixit ad eos:
he shook out his garments and said to them:
“Your blood is on your own heads. I am clean.
I will go to the Gentiles.”
he entered into the house of a certain man,
whose house was adjoined to the synagogue.
Crispus autem archisynagogus credidit Domino cum omni domo sua:
Now Crispus, a leader of the synagogue, believed in the Lord,
with his entire house. And many of the Corinthians, upon hearing,
Dixit autem Dominus nocte per visionem Paulo:
Then the Lord said to Paul, through a vision in the night:
Instead, speak out and do not be silent.
et nemo apponetur tibi ut noceat te:
And no one will take hold of you, so as to do you harm.
quoniam populus est mihi multus in hac civitate.
For many of the people in this city are with me.”
Sedit autem ibi annum et sex menses,
Then he settled there for a year and six months,
teaching the Word of God among them.
But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia,
insurrexerunt uno animo Judæi in Paulum,
the Jews rose up with one accord against Paul.
And they brought him to the tribunal,
Quia contra legem hic persuadet hominibus colere Deum.
“He persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”
Then, when Paul was beginning to open his mouth,
Si quidem esset iniquum aliquid aut facinus pessimum,
“If this were some matter of injustice, or a wicked deed,
I would support you, as is proper.
Si vero quæstiones sunt de verbo,
Yet if truly these are questions about a word
you should see to it yourselves.
I will not be the judge of such things.”
And he ordered them from the tribunal.
Apprehendentes autem omnes Sosthenem principem synagogæ,
But they, apprehending Sosthenes, a leader of the synagogue,
beat him in front of the tribunal.
et nihil eorum Gallioni curæ erat.
And Gallio showed no concern for these things.
Paulus vero cum adhuc sustinuisset dies multos fratribus valefaciens,
Yet truly, Paul, after he had remained for many more days,
navigavit in Syriam (et cum eo Priscilla et Aquila),
having said goodbye to the brothers, sailed into Syria, and with him were Priscilla and Aquila.
qui sibi totonderat in Cenchris caput:
Now he had shaved his head in Cenchreae,
for he had made a vow.
and he left them behind there.
Yet truly, he himself, entering into the synagogue,
Rogantibus autem eis ut ampliori tempore maneret,
Then, although they were asking him to remain for a longer time,
And after going down to Caesarea,
and he greeted the Church there,
and then he descended to Antioch.
Et facto ibi aliquanto tempore profectus est,
And having spent some length of time there,
and he walked in order through the region of Galatia and Phrygia,
Now a certain Jew named Apollo,
Alexandrinus genere, vir eloquens, devenit Ephesum,
an eloquent man who was powerful with the Scriptures,
He was learned in the Way of the Lord.
et docebat diligenter ea quæ sunt Jesu,
he was speaking and teaching the things that are of Jesus,
but knowing only the baptism of John.
Hic ergo cœpit fiducialiter agere in synagoga.
Quem cum audissent Priscilla et Aquila,
he began to act faithfully in the synagogue.
And when Priscilla and Aquila had heard him,
et diligentius exposuerunt ei viam Domini.
they took him aside and expounded the Way of the Lord to him more thoroughly.
Then, since he wanted to go to Achaia,
exhortati fratres, scripserunt discipulis ut susciperent eum.
the brothers wrote an exhortation to the disciples, so that they might accept him.
he held many discussions with those who had believed.
For he was vehemently and publicly reproving the Jews,
ostendens per Scripturas esse Christum Jesum.
by revealing through the Scriptures that Jesus is the Christ.
